topic: yubiOS sealed-UKI VM debug playbook (yubi-OS/yubiOS playbooks/sealed-uki-vm-debug.md)

subtopics.scope: What the sealed-UKI VM lane is: ci_test_sealed-uki-vm.yml builds a PKCS#11-signed UKI (SoftHSM slot emulating PIV 9c), boots it under OVMF Secure Boot, runs negative tamper tests; 3 jobs (build-and-verify-uki, boot-secure-vm, negative-tamper-tests), 6 assertions; canonical pattern ci_mkosi-installer.yml.
seed_queries: systemd UKI unified kernel image ukify secure boot signing
PKCS#11 OpenSSL 3 provider SoftHSM signing token

subtopics.scope: The playbook's four decision rules: diff against the canonical never improvise, trust nothing in workflow comments, check parse state before step logs, one change per iteration with a verifying step.

Row 0 of the decision tree: conclusion=failure in about 0s with jobs total_count: 0 means the YAML did not parse and no step ran; unquoted colon inside a step name reads as a flow-mapping key under YAML 1.1; PyYAML quirks (on: parsed as True) that must not be 'fixed'.
seed_queries: YAML unquoted colon step name parse error GitHub Actions workflow
PyYAML YAML 1.1 on key parsed as boolean True safe_load

subtopics.scope: Rows 1 and 2: systemd-sbsign ships inside the systemd package at /usr/lib/systemd/systemd-sbsign and is not on PATH (no dnf package exists; 'No match for argument' is expected); each docker run is a fresh ephemeral container so a dnf install in one does not persist; the sign command needs --private-key-source=provider:pkcs11 not engine:pkcs11 (ADR-008 / OMN-116, OpenSSL 3.x deprecates the engine API); the PKCS#11 URI must be single-quoted with the embedded PIN (pin-value) or signing hangs or C_Login fails.
seed_queries: systemd-sbsign ukify binary location PATH systemd package signing
OpenSSL 3 provider pkcs11 versus engine API deprecated pkcs11 URI pin-value

subtopics.scope: Rows 3 to 6: 'cpio: chown failed - No data available' installing softhsm when a host mount shadows the RPM's own file target /var/lib/softhsm (cross-mount to /run/yubios-hsm and point SOFTHSM2_CONF directories.tokendir there, or drop the mount); two docker run invocations with the same -v mount can diverge (cert missing at /output/pki/sb.crt, EISDIR on single-file bind-mounts); cross-version SoftHSM BDB token files (host 2.6.1 vs container 2.7.0) unreadable across versions ('Input/output error'); set -euo pipefail plus a docker run declaring only some -e vars gives 'KEY_P8_B64: unbound variable' with no other output.
seed_queries: SoftHSM2 token BDB database version incompatible cross version error
docker run environment variables unbound variable set -u bash -c

subtopics.scope: Row 7: 'EVP_DigestSignUpdate: provider signature failure' (030000EA) on ECDSA is not a workflow bug; SoftHSM 2.7.0 added hashed ECDSA mechanisms but implemented them single-part only while pkcs11-provider streams TBS bytes via C_SignUpdate; upstream SoftHSMv2 issue 842 (open), fix in PR 857 merged to main; pkcs11-provider issue 715 closed won't-fix provider-side; two fixes in order: pin pkcs11-provider >= 1.2.0 (PR 669 softhsm fallback, verify with rpm -q) or swap the CI token to kryoptic (only --module and --token-label change).
seed_queries: SoftHSM 2.7.0 hashed ECDSA single-part C_SignUpdate issue 842
pkcs11-provider 1.2.0 softhsm fallback PR 669 kryoptic ECDSA

subtopics.scope: Row 8: boot-secure-vm failing at the OVMF level; as of the playbook date neither ci_test_sealed-uki-vm.yml nor ci_test-vgpu-vm.yml provisions OVMF_CODE.fd / OVMF_VARS.fd or enrolls the yubiOS ROTPK into the db, and an OVMF rejection masks that enrollment gap (do not read it as a signing failure); OVMF artifacts come from ci_fork_edk2.yml.

EDK2 OVMF firmware build artifacts secure boot key enrollment CI

subtopics.scope: The Verified working record: the V25 to V39 failure timeline (runs #33 to #51 with the row each hit), the explicit statement that the lane had not yet produced a green signed-UKI build at 2026-08-01, the PR #154 / PR #155 lane-opening and stub-fill merge, and the later green path: commit 1d0666d77c0b (V83) tuned arm64 boot_timeout 900 to 1200 s to GREEN at run 30652859000.

Cross-references and open gaps recorded by the playbook: BLOCKERS.md B-BOOTC-SEAL (Phase 1 artifact split shipped in PR #143 / a1940330; Phase 2 install-time BLSConfig wiring plus Secure Boot and negative-tamper evidence still open), Permanent CI-Evidence Patterns, Linear OMN-43 (parent), OMN-52, OMN-47, OMN-53, OMN-150 (Phase 2), OMN-116 (ADR-008), ADR-008 / ADR-022 / ADR-032, sibling refs and playbooks, gaps 1 and 12 (no tests/vm/test-secure-boot-tamper.sh; negatives 2 and 3 TODO-only), and the proposal that a yaml.safe_load pre-dispatch gate would have caught V37/V38 free.
